newsitem.title: THAILAND: Tanayong details its unit's share sales.
newsitem.headline: Tanayong details its unit's share sales.

text.p: Thai property developer Tanayong Plc said on Friday that the company had reached agreement with a group of institutional investors to sell 173.17 million new shares in its unit, Bangkok Transit System Co Ltd (BTSC).
The share price of BTSC was set at 15.80 baht each, Tanayong said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
BTSC is building an elevated electric train system in the Thai capital and plans to go public early next year.
Major investors of BTSC new shares are Italian-Thai Developement Plc (65.2 million shares), Rictor Assets Co Ltd (38.36 million) and Land and House Plc (22.15 million), Tanayong said.
Under the agreement, Tanyong will also have to buy an additional 254.15 million shares in BTSC at 10 baht each, the company said.
After the share purchase, Tanayong will own 69.29 percent of BTSC while Italian-Thai Development, Rictor Assets and Land and House will hold 8.62, 6.07 and 2.93 percent, Tanayong said.
BTSC will also issue convertible debentures worth 2.74 billion baht ($110 million) that will be privately offered to the existing nine major shareholders, Tanayong said.
The debentures will be sold in proportion with each shareholders' stake in BTSC, it added.
